name: aspirecures-weekly-research
description: Weekly research pipeline for AspireCURES: collect, curate, render, commit disease pages

preparer.description: Collects from Europe PMC + PubMed + ClinicalTrials.gov + ISRCTN, applies Claude curation gate, emits JSON report

commit_agent.description: Consumes JSON report, renders 9 disease pages, validates against lint-feed.pl and verify.sh, commits and pushes
commit_agent.trigger: cronjob delivery → user response in chat

key_guardrails: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY needed — the agent IS the model using its own Claude judgments for the curation gate
Append-only data merges with date-churn signature comparison
Skip and record if credentials unavailable (Europe PMC API key is free, PubMed is free)
Never commit unverified output — check lint-feed.pl and verify.sh before committing
